## About
Bill Eserini grew up in South San Francisco working with his father at the family gas station, where he picked up his love for cars. After a stint at FAR Performance in Mountain View, he opened his own shop and built a name as an honest, hardworking and competitively priced repair shop. Today the shop sits on Robert Avenue in Santa Clara.
His sons Mat and Andrew work in the family business now. Andrew is head mechanic and ASE Master Tech certified, Mat trained in engine performance, electrical, suspension and steering, and assistant tech Greg Sanchez trained through the Sequoia Institute.
We handle oil changes, tune-ups, wheel alignments, pre-buyer inspections, engine and transmission work and more, for foreign and domestic makes. Neighbors rate us 4.7 on Google from 41 reviews.

## Services
- Mile service checks: Scheduled service checks at 60, 90 and 120 mile marks.
- Foreign and domestic repair: Repair for makes from Acura and BMW to Ford, Honda, Toyota and Volkswagen, with factory honored maintenance schedules.
- Engine and transmission repair: Engine and transmission repair and rebuilds.
- Air conditioning service: Air conditioning service to keep your car cool.
- Hybrid service: Service for hybrid vehicles as well as gas cars and trucks.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 7:30 to 5:30, and closed on weekends.

Q: Can I text the shop?
A: Yes. You can text us at 408-661-8417.

Q: Can you get me home after I drop off my car?
A: We offer a shuttle within 3 miles, and ride share is available with an appointment.
